sauna_description: The sauna is an old Latvian historical and cultural tradition. The Latvian sauna is special for its rituals, which use medicinal herbs, whisks and other natural materials. A sauna ritual is a procedure of aromatherapy, body massage and relaxation for the mind. For some it feels like an unforgettable flight; for others it is the start of a new chapter. Peace, wellbeing and lightness are what every visitor takes away. The Gravas sauna is a place to savour every moment, unhurried, in a homely rural setting.
wedding_description: Gravas sits in a picturesque spot by the forest, well suited to a celebration in nature. A venue for up to 60 guests, a ceremony site, a bonfire for the midnight traditions, beds for the night, spacious grounds and easy access are provided for everyone. Celebrations are hosted in season, from May to September.
accommodation_description: Near Bauska, Gravas offers overnight accommodation for everyone. Beds are on the upper floor of the guesthouse; downstairs there is a small kitchen, a lounge and facilities. The grounds are spacious, with sports courts, a barbecue and a bonfire site.
